svg.title: Suminagashi: four weeks of contributions as floating ink
svg.desc: Each day from 22 October to 18 November 2026 falls into a bath of water as a drop of ink, wider for a busier day: 1401 contributions on 28 days.
svg.text: A drop for every day of the last four weeks; a busier day, a wider ring.
OCT 22 – NOV 18 · 1401 CONTRIBUTIONS ON 28 OF 28 DAYS · BUSIEST NOV 17 (158), IN VERMILION
